Consider the following PR description:
TypeRegistry duplicate detection broken for T field

#### Description

When registering multiple TypeSpec instances with the same T field, the duplicate detection logic fails to properly identify conflicts. The registry allows registration of specs with duplicate T values when it should reject them.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "ariga.io/atlas/schemahcl"
)

func main() {
    registry := &schemahcl.TypeRegistry{}
    
    spec1 := &schemahcl.TypeSpec{
        Name: "first",
        T:    "duplicate_t",
    }
    
    spec2 := &schemahcl.TypeSpec{
        Name: "second", 
        T:    "duplicate_t",  // Same T as spec1
    }
    
    // This should fail but doesn't
    err := registry.Register(spec1, spec2)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Printf("Expected error: %v\n", err)
    } else {
        fmt.Println("Registration succeeded when it should have failed")
    }
}
```

The registration succeeds when it should return an error about duplicate T values. The duplicate check appears to be checking the wrong field or using incorrect logic.
</pr_description>

// PrintType returns the string representation of a column type which can be parsed
// by the driver into a schema.Type.
func (r *TypeRegistry) PrintType(typ *Type) (string, error) {
	spec, ok := r.findT(typ.T)
	if !ok {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("specutil: type %q not found in registry", typ.T)
	}
	if len(spec.Attributes) == 0 {
		return typ.T, nil
	}
	var (
		args        []string
		mid, suffix string
	)
	for _, arg := range typ.Attrs {
		// TODO(rotemtam): make this part of the TypeSpec
		if arg.K == "unsigned" {
			b, err := arg.Bool()
			if err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			if b {
				suffix += " unsigned"
			}
			continue

		attr, ok := spec.Attr(arg.K)

			return "", fmt.Errorf("specutil: attribute %q not found in typespec %q", arg.K, typ.T)

		args = append(args, valueArgs(attr, arg.V)...)
	}
	if len(args) > 0 {
		mid = "(" + strings.Join(args, ",") + ")"
	}
	return typ.T + mid + suffix, nil
}
